description: Returns all admins for a workspace with their permission levels.

pathParameters.name: workspaceID
pathParameters.description: Workspace UUID. Obtain from API call: GET /v1/mobility/workspaces

fields.name: total
fields.description: Total number of records matching the query, ignoring pagination.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Number of records skipped (echoes the `offset` query parameter).

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Page size applied (echoes the `limit` query parameter).

children.name: permissions
children.description: Mobility permissions for the admin. `null` when the admin has no role bindings (e.g. pending invitation).

children.name: umr
children.description: Mobile Routing permission level. - `ALL` — can view and configure devices (admin) - `VIEW_ONLY` — read-only access (viewer) - `NONE` — no access

remote.python:
import http.client


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.ui.com")
payload = ''
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>'
}
conn.request("GET", "/v1/mobility/workspaces/{workspaceID}/admins", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
